violation_type.title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation stated they did not record meal substitutions.

finding_variants.text: The operation stated they did not record meal substitutions.

Menu substitutions were being made without being recorded. This was corrected at inspection when a discussion was had with the person in charge about tracking menu substitutions and the substitutsions for today were logged.
The posted daily menu did not have the posted substitutions for the day.     Note: This was corrected during inspection.
Menu's observed did not have dates on them.
At the time of the inspection, there was no record of menu substitutions or past menus,
The operation did not document meal and snack substitutions.

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: There is sufficient evidence to support the claim that the menu is not followed and substitutions are not documented.

Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The PM snack menu showed children would be served fresh apples and sun butter. During today's inspection children were served oranges and crackers as well as oranges and pancakes for PM snack.

Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: Substitutions for lunch were not made when the children ate cheese pizza but the weekly menu stated mac and cheese. This was corrected when the substitution was added.

Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: This standard was tasked as part of an investigation and found deficient. The operation served a substitution to the menu This was not documented on the menu provided to parents.
Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The operation stated they did not record meal substitutions.

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The posted menu was not reflective of the food served. The menu only stated fish sticks and mixed vegetables. Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The posted menu was not reflective of the food served. The menu stated smotherd pork chops, mashed potates, green beans, and strawberries. Children  were observed to be served fish sticks, and Chex Mix. Some were served wheat thins as well.
Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The menu did not match what was served for lunch.     The menu stated sloppy joes and I observed mashed potatoes with corn and bread.
Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The operation did not update their Food Menu Chart for the month of May 2026 to reflect substitutions made to meal serve to the children.

Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: Food items substituted for PM snack and supper were not documented.

Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The menu posted did not reflect what the children ate for lunch today. The operation has a rotating menu and the substitution was not documented.
Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: At the time of inspection, no substitution list was available as they didn't have apple juice but had teddy grahams for snack.
Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: Food items served during the day do not match the menu posted.
Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The operation did not properly document substitutions to the daily meals as required.
Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The operation has not been keep a record of snacks served.
